_what: Make a signing key inside the person's vault, under the name the input gives: an Ed25519 key the vault makes and never lets out (the door's secrets:generate {name}, which answers {name, scheme, public_key} and refuses a name already held, keeping its value). Input: {name}. Used by a saved setup list's choice for what needs a key of the account's own, such as connecting accounts by signing in (sign-in-state-key, the key that signs a sign-in's state). The step asks the door method itself: the AI walking the run calls it at @secrets and answers the step with what the vault said.

definitions.name: Make a signing key in the vault
